<!doctype html>
<html lang="ko"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>HOJA · 호자 게임</title>
<style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Noto Sans KR",sans-serif}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;color:#e8f5fa;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#102e42 0,#08141f 85%);min-height:100vh}
header{max-width:1120px;margin:auto;padding:18px 20px 13px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:15px;flex-wrap:wrap}
h1{font-size:19px;margin:0 0 5px}header p{font-size:12px;color:#a9c4d3;margin:0}
.eyebrow{letter-spacing:.17em;color:#90c9dd;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:5px}
#stage{max-width:1120px;margin:auto;padding:0 20px}
#frame{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#51b8ec;border:1px solid #487387;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 15px 60px #0008}
#frame{cursor:pointer}
#phaserRoot{position:absolute;inset:0}
#phaserRoot canvas{width:100%!important;height:auto!important;aspect-ratio:16/9;display:block;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated}
#blackCut{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:9;background:#000;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
#hojaLogo{position:absolute;z-index:10;width:54%;max-width:570px;left:50%;top:15%;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translate(-50%,-530px);filter:drop-shadow(0 13px 0 #12253b99);}
.logoBox{border:7px solid #3a253f;background:#ffde8b;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 5px #ffbd69,9px 10px 0 #26354a,0 0 0 4px #f6a867;border-radius:14px;padding:21px 12px;text-align:center;position:relative}
.logoBox .main{color:#75334d;font-size:clamp(28px,5.9vw,76px);font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.04em;text-shadow:3px 3px #fff0aa,5px 6px #c66e64;line-height:1.2;white-space:nowrap}
.logoBox img{position:absolute;top:-74px;width:110px;height:110px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:auto;filter:drop-shadow(2px 4px #44385777)}
.logoBox .portraitLeft{left:-52px;transform:rotate(-13deg)}.logoBox .portraitRight{right:-51px;transform:rotate(13deg)}
.logoSub{display:block;margin-top:6px;font-weight:900;color:#8d4a58;font-size:clamp(10px,1.5vw,15px);letter-spacing:.2em}

.footer{max-width:1120px;margin:14px auto;padding:0 20px 25px;display:grid;gap:12px}
.actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
button{background:#25495b;color:#e8f5fa;border:1px solid #57778a;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 12px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:700}
button:hover{background:#426b7f}#elapsed,#status{color:#a9bdc9;font-size:12px}
#progressWrap{width:100%;height:6px;background:#243b49;border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden}
#progress{height:100%;width:0;background:#dfbe77;transition:width .1s linear}
.anchors{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px}.anchors button{padding:6px 10px;font-size:11px;background:#1d3445}
.note{font-size:12px;color:#a5b8c2;line-height:1.65}.note strong{color:#d9eff3}
#hiddenArt{display:none}
@media(max-width:600px){header{padding-top:13px}.logoBox{padding:10px 6px;border-width:4px}.logoBox img{width:54px;height:54px;top:-33px}.logoBox .portraitLeft{left:-25px}.logoBox .portraitRight{right:-25px}}

/* Loader sits on top of the Phaser attract at the exact completion beat. */
#loadingOverlay,#readyMock{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:40;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;text-align:center;padding:30px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 20%,#24779a 0%,#102d49 66%,#0a1a2d 100%)}
#loadingOverlay[hidden],#readyMock[hidden]{display:none!important}
.loadingTitle{font-size:clamp(20px,3.8vw,40px);font-weight:1000;color:#ffe19e;text-shadow:3px 4px 0 #0a2036;margin-bottom:10px}
.loadingRow{width:min(900px,95%);display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:clamp(10px,2vw,26px);align-items:center;min-height:180px}
.loadingCharacter{width:128px;height:128px;min-width:128px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated;align-self:center}
.loadingActor{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;flex:0 0 128px}.loadingName{margin-top:1px;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(13px,1.55vw,19px);color:#f9e4b2;text-shadow:2px 3px 0 #081c2a;white-space:nowrap}.loadingCenter{flex:1;max-width:565px;min-width:0}
.loadingText{display:inline;font-size:clamp(13px,2vw,24px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.65;text-shadow:2px 3px 0 #061a2b;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.loadingDots{display:inline-block;min-width:2.2em;color:#ffe19e;font-weight:900}
.loadingTrack{height:12px;border:2px solid #d5ecf3;background:#11374b;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;width:min(480px,75%);margin:28px auto 8px}
.loadingFill{height:100%;width:28%;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#fbd682 0 22px,#efb355 22px 28px);animation:barTravel 1.5s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
@keyframes barTravel{from{transform:translateX(-100%)}to{transform:translateX(360%)}}
.loadingNote{font-size:12px;color:#c0d9e9;margin-top:12px}

#readyMock h2{font-size:clamp(23px,4vw,46px);color:#ffe19e}
#readyMock p{line-height:1.8;max-width:560px}
#readyMock button{margin:10px;padding:12px 18px}
@media(max-width:600px){.loadingActor{flex-basis:64px}.loadingName{font-size:11px}.loadingCharacter{width:64px;height:64px;min-width:64px}.loadingRow{min-height:130px;gap:5px}.loadingText{font-size:12px}.loadingTitle{margin-bottom:0}}

/* STEP 14-2: fixed navigation anchor is shared by grade, subject, publisher, units and future modes. */
.hmSelectedUnits{display:none!important}
#hojaSharedBack{position:absolute;left:clamp(10px,2.2%,24px);top:clamp(10px,3.1%,22px);z-index:86;background:#14354a;border:2px solid #e5c78c;color:#fff1cc;min-width:142px;min-height:42px;padding:7px 13px;font-size:14px;box-shadow:3px 4px 0 #101e2c}
#hojaSharedBack[hidden]{display:none!important}
#hojaCatalog,#hojaNextMode{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:70;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% -15%,#315c66,#142d3e 70%,#091926);color:#fff3cf;cursor:default}
#hojaCatalog[hidden],#hojaNextMode[hidden]{display:none!important}
.hcHeader{width:100%;padding:clamp(45px,7.8%,70px) 15px 10px;text-align:center;flex:0 0 auto}
.hcKicker{font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(10px,1.3vw,14px);letter-spacing:.21em;color:#9ec4b8}
.hcTitle{font-size:clamp(23px,3.7vw,42px);font-weight:1000;margin:5px auto;color:#fff1c6;letter-spacing:.04em;text-shadow:3px 4px #1c2028}
.hcContext{font-size:clamp(11px,1.35vw,16px);color:#d3e1db;font-weight:700;min-height:19px}
.hcRail{width:min(930px,95%);flex:1;min-height:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:safe center;gap:18px;padding:10px 15px 20px;overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;scrollbar-color:#bc996a #1d3d4c}
.hcPak{position:relative;display:flex;flex:0 0 clamp(128px,16vw,185px);height:clamp(170px,33vh,245px);max-height:85%;min-width:0;align-items:stretch;justify-content:stretch;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:9px 9px 18px 18px;background:linear-gradient(92deg,#84654c 0 6%,#c9a77a 6% 12%,#bf966a 12% 89%,#725b4c 89% 94%,#513d32 94%);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 5px #5d493b,inset 0 0 0 9px #e2bf86,5px 7px 0 #06121a;transform:translateY(0);transition:transform .15s ease,filter .15s ease;color:#e9eff3;cursor:pointer}
.hcPak:hover,.hcPak:focus-visible{transform:translateY(-7px);filter:brightness(1.13);outline:3px solid #f2d58c;outline-offset:2px}
.hcPak:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}
.hcPak.isSelected{outline:4px solid #8ee5b0;outline-offset:3px}
.hcPak:before{content:'';position:absolute;top:9px;left:18%;right:18%;height:10px;border-radius:0 0 5px 5px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#76533b 0 5px,#e4c086 5px 10px)}
.hcPak:after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:7px;left:20%;right:20%;height:9px;border-radius:3px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#3c3430 0 5px,#f2d7a0 5px 13px)}
.hcFace{position:absolute;inset:26px 12px 23px;border:3px solid #4a5350;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#284b4e,#173741);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;padding:12px 8px;text-align:center;border-radius:2px}
.hcEmblem{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#e2bf82;border:3px double #78543b;color:#644a35;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;font-weight:1000;font-size:22px}
.hcFace strong{color:#fff2cc;font-weight:1000;font-size:clamp(14px,2vw,22px);line-height:1.25;overflow-wrap:anywhere;max-width:100%}
.hcFace small{font-size:clamp(9px,1.15vw,12px);line-height:1.3;color:#addbd7;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.hcFoot{flex:0 0 auto;width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;padding:0 15px clamp(18px,3%,23px);font-size:12px;color:#bcd0d6;text-align:center}
.hcAction{background:#d6a86c;border:2px solid #fff0c7;color:#152c39;font-size:14px;padding:7px 15px}
.hcMockBadge{position:absolute;right:14px;top:14px;color:#b6cbd0;background:#102634bc;border:1px solid #597780;border-radius:5px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em}
.hcNextCard{width:min(660px,86%);margin:auto;padding:25px;border:2px solid #ddc390;background:#183c43;border-radius:12px;text-align:center}
.hcNextCard h2{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:clamp(25px,3vw,37px);color:#ffdfa1}
.hcNextCard p{font-size:clamp(12px,1.5vw,16px);line-height:1.7}
@media(max-width:680px){#hojaSharedBack{min-width:104px;min-height:32px;padding:5px 7px;font-size:11px}.hcPak{flex-basis:116px;height:165px}.hcRail{gap:11px;padding-left:7px;padding-right:7px}.hcFace{inset:22px 9px 19px;padding:6px}.hcEmblem{width:34px;height:34px;font-size:18px}.hcTitle{font-size:23px}.hcHeader{padding-top:40px}.hcFoot{padding-bottom:10px;font-size:10px}}

/* Google Noto subject icon marks: same-size, undistorted square images. */
.hcEmblem{width:52px;height:52px;flex:0 0 52px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden}
.hcSubjectIcon{display:block;width:35px;height:35px;object-fit:contain;aspect-ratio:1 / 1;image-rendering:auto;flex:0 0 auto}
@media(max-width:680px){.hcEmblem{width:43px;height:43px;flex-basis:43px}.hcSubjectIcon{width:29px;height:29px}}
</style>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/phaser@4.2.1/dist/phaser.min.js"></script>
<script>if(!window.Phaser){let fallback=document.createElement('script');fallback.src='https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/phaser/4.2.1/phaser.min.js';fallback.async=false;document.head.appendChild(fallback);}</script>
<style>
/* V0.4.4 – catalog selection behavior and long-title treatment */
.hcPakWrap{position:relative;flex:0 0 clamp(128px,16vw,185px);height:clamp(205px,42vh,245px);max-height:85%;min-width:0}
.hcPakWrap>.hcPak{width:100%;height:100%;max-height:none;flex:0 0 auto}
.hcPak.isUnit .hcFace{gap:4px;padding:6px 5px}.hcPak.isUnit .hcEmblem{width:43px;height:43px;flex-basis:43px}.hcPak.isUnit .hcFace small{white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:100%;font-size:10px;flex:0 0 auto}.hcPak.isUnit .hcFace strong{font-size:clamp(12px,1.55vw,18px);line-height:1.23;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:3;line-clamp:3;overflow:hidden;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.hcPak.isUnit.isLong .hcFace strong{font-size:clamp(11px,1.4vw,16px)}
.hcInfoBtn{position:absolute;right:11px;top:26px;z-index:2;width:28px;height:28px;border:1px solid #f2d58c;border-radius:50%;background:#112f3b;color:#ffe5a4;font-size:18px;line-height:23px;text-align:center;cursor:pointer}
.hcInfoBtn:hover,.hcInfoBtn:focus-visible{background:#386e71;outline:2px solid #fff2bf}
.hcMultiControls[hidden],.hcUnitInfoPanel[hidden]{display:none!important}
.hcMultiControls{order:2;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex:0 0 auto;padding:0 14px 7px;font-weight:900;color:#fff2d0}
.hcMultiSwitch{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;cursor:pointer;padding:5px 11px;border:2px solid #a88755;border-radius:12px;background:#102d3b}
.hcMultiSwitch input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px}
.hcSwitchTrack{width:45px;height:24px;border-radius:20px;background:#657e84;border:2px solid #d5d9d2;position:relative;transition:background .16s}
.hcSwitchTrack:before{content:'';position:absolute;width:16px;height:16px;background:#f7e6c1;border-radius:50%;left:2px;top:2px;transition:transform .16s}
.hcMultiSwitch input:checked+.hcSwitchTrack{background:#387d60}
.hcMultiSwitch input:checked+.hcSwitchTrack:before{transform:translateX(21px)}
.hcMultiSwitch input:focus-visible+.hcSwitchTrack{outline:3px solid #fff2be;outline-offset:3px}
.hcMultiCount{color:#c5e1dc;font-size:12px}
.hcFoot{order:3;min-height:54px;flex-wrap:wrap;padding-bottom:12px}
.hcAction{min-height:38px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:900}.hcAction:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:not-allowed}
.hcUnitInfoPanel{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:98;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#081720cf;padding:20px}
.hcUnitInfoBox{width:min(590px,94%);padding:24px;border:3px solid #e1be7c;border-radius:12px;background:#163c45;box-shadow:10px 10px 0 #06131a;text-align:center;color:#fff5d8}
.hcUnitInfoKicker{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#d2b87e}
.hcUnitInfoName{font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(16px,2.4vw,26px);line-height:1.6;margin:20px 0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
#hcUnitInfoClose{padding:9px 26px;border:2px solid #e2c38a;background:#e2b876;color:#132e36;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer}
.hcNextSelected{background:#102b32;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:6px;font-weight:900;color:#fee2a1;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
@media(max-width:680px){.hcPakWrap{flex-basis:116px;height:185px}.hcPak.isUnit .hcFace strong{font-size:12px}.hcPak.isUnit.isLong .hcFace strong{font-size:11px}.hcInfoBtn{right:3px;top:20px;width:24px;height:24px;font-size:15px;line-height:20px}.hcMultiControls{gap:6px}.hcMultiCount{font-size:10px}.hcFoot{font-size:11px;min-height:50px}}
</style>
<style>
/* V0.4.4: the single circled-i character travels WITH the card hover. */
.hcPakWrap>.hcInfoBtn{width:25px;height:28px;right:10px;top:25px;padding:0;border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;background:transparent!important;box-shadow:none!important;color:#ffe4a0;font-size:24px;line-height:28px;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #07202b;transition:transform .15s ease,color .15s ease;outline-offset:2px}
.hcPakWrap:hover>.hcPak,.hcPakWrap:focus-within>.hcPak{transform:translateY(-7px);filter:brightness(1.13)}
.hcPakWrap:hover>.hcInfoBtn,.hcPakWrap:focus-within>.hcInfoBtn{transform:translateY(-7px);color:#fff9d1}
.hcPakWrap>.hcInfoBtn:hover,.hcPakWrap>.hcInfoBtn:focus-visible{background:transparent!important;color:white;outline:2px solid #fff0b7}
/* Game selection UI above the authentic autumn stage. */
#hojaNextMode{background:#fff0d6;color:#193745;overflow:hidden;align-items:stretch;z-index:70}
.hmHeading{flex:0 0 auto;position:relative;z-index:3;text-align:center;padding:clamp(42px,8%,53px) 18px 0}
.hmHeading .hcKicker{color:#9c592d}.hmHeading h2{font-size:clamp(23px,3.6vw,40px);font-weight:1000;margin:3px 0;color:#5c2e36;text-shadow:2px 3px 0 #e1c3a0}
.hmHeading p{font-size:clamp(11px,1.3vw,15px);font-weight:800;margin:0 0 2px;color:#7c4e49;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis;overflow:hidden}
.hmSelections{position:relative;z-index:3;flex:0 0 auto;min-height:102px;max-width:900px;width:96%;margin:8px auto 0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hmPick{position:relative;min-width:min(35vw,210px);min-height:96px;padding:14px 16px;background:#f7e7c8;border:4px solid #73534a;border-radius:9px;color:#53383b;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 4px #d9a66b,5px 7px 0 #6a4537;font-weight:1000;transition:transform .14s ease,filter .14s ease;cursor:pointer}
.hmPick strong{display:block;font-size:clamp(18px,2.3vw,28px);white-space:nowrap}
.hmPick small{display:block;font-size:clamp(10px,1.15vw,13px);margin-top:5px;color:#826454}
.hmPick:hover,.hmPick:focus-visible{transform:translateY(-5px);filter:brightness(1.05);outline:3px solid #9b673e;outline-offset:3px}
.hmSelections.teamCount{max-width:920px;gap:12px}
.hmSelections.teamCount .hmPick{min-width:0;width:clamp(85px,12%,115px);min-height:104px;padding:11px 8px}
.hmSelections.teamCount .hmPick strong{font-size:clamp(25px,3vw,36px)}
.hmSelections.teamCount .hmPick small{font-size:12px}
.hmSelectionHint{position:relative;z-index:3;flex:0 0 auto;text-align:center;margin:13px auto 1px;font-size:clamp(12px,1.25vw,15px);font-weight:850;color:#7d4b40;max-width:90%;line-height:1.4}
.hmLandscape{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:45%;z-index:1;overflow:hidden;background:#fff0cf;border-top:4px solid #e6b471;pointer-events:none}
.hmLandscape canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;image-rendering:pixelated;object-fit:fill}
.hmAutumnCaption{position:absolute;bottom:9px;right:12px;color:#fff0ca;text-shadow:2px 2px 0 #2b2030;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.13em;font-weight:900}
.hmSelectedUnits{position:absolute;z-index:3;top:55%;width:82%;left:9%;text-align:center;font-size:11px;max-height:30px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;color:#f7e5bb;text-shadow:2px 2px #49323a;pointer-events:none}
.hmSelections.finalChoice .hmPick{min-width:220px;background:#d4e2cc;border-color:#67865b}
@media(max-width:670px){.hmHeading{padding-top:38px}.hmSelections{gap:8px;min-height:100px;margin-top:5px}.hmPick{min-height:80px;min-width:39%;padding:8px}.hmPick strong{font-size:16px}.hmPick small{font-size:10px}.hmSelections.teamCount{gap:7px}.hmSelections.teamCount .hmPick{width:29%;min-height:55px;padding:3px}.hmSelections.teamCount .hmPick strong{font-size:23px}.hmSelections.teamCount .hmPick small{font-size:9px}.hmLandscape{height:39%}.hmSelectionHint{margin:6px auto}.hmSelectedUnits{display:none}.hcPakWrap>.hcInfoBtn{right:2px;top:19px;font-size:20px}}
</style>
<style>
/* V0.4.8 — mode transition without shake/fade; randomized four-season scroll lock */
#hojaRepoChoice{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:71;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:18px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0,#315c66,#142d3e 70%,#091926);color:#fff3cf}
#hojaRepoChoice[hidden],#hrPrivatePanel[hidden]{display:none!important}
.hrHeader{text-align:center;padding:0 12px}.hrHeader .hcKicker{font-size:12px}.hrHeader h2{color:#ffe0ac;font-weight:1000;font-size:clamp(25px,4vw,40px);margin:8px 0 5px}.hrHeader p{font-size:clamp(12px,1.5vw,18px);margin:0;color:#c4dcdd}
.hrChoices{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:stretch;gap:20px;width:min(800px,90%)}
.hrCard{width:45%;min-height:155px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#f5e4be,#cba775);border:5px solid #6f523f;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 5px #e7c98f,6px 8px 0 #081b24;border-radius:9px;color:#4c3738;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;transition:transform .15s,filter .15s;padding:14px}
.hrCard:hover,.hrCard:focus-visible{background:#ffecca;color:#4c3738;transform:translateY(-5px);filter:brightness(1.06);outline:3px solid #f7cf7b}
.hrIcon{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,45px)}.hrCard strong{font-size:clamp(16px,2vw,25px)}.hrCard small{font-size:clamp(10px,1.3vw,15px);color:#745a50}
.hrPrivate{min-height:83px;text-align:center;width:min(500px,94%);padding:8px 12px;border:2px solid #a88a66;border-radius:9px;background:#183b48}
.hrPrivate label{display:block;margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:800;font-size:13px}.hrCodeRow{display:flex;gap:9px;justify-content:center}.hrCodeRow input{min-width:0;max-width:140px;text-align:center;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#1e3d46;background:#fff8e5;font-size:20px;font-weight:900;border-radius:5px;border:2px solid #d7b985;padding:5px}.hrCodeRow button{background:#e3bd80;color:#263944;border:2px solid #fff0c7;padding:6px 16px;font-weight:950}.hrPrivate p{font-size:11px;min-height:15px;color:#f5da9d;margin:5px 0}
.hrDemo{color:#a9c2c6;text-align:center;font-size:11px;max-width:85%;margin:2px 0}
/* Remove English adventure subheading without leaving unused header space. */
.hmHeading{padding-top:clamp(48px,8%,59px)}.hmHeading .hcKicker{display:none}.hmAutumnCaption{display:none}
/* Longer descriptions stay fully visible. */
.hmSelections:not(.teamCount) .hmPick{min-width:min(38vw,255px);min-height:112px;padding:16px 19px}
.hmPick small{white-space:normal;line-height:1.45;overflow-wrap:keep-all;color:#6a4f46;max-width:250px;margin:7px auto 0}
/* gather cleanly, replace at center, then deal next choices outward */
/* Gather once at the true rail centre. Never shake, rotate or fade. */
.hmPick.hmGather{pointer-events:none;animation:hmGatherCenter .40s cubic-bezier(.36,.03,.74,.43) both!important;}
/* Newly rendered choices start at that same centre and spread to their slots. */
.hmPick.hmDeal{pointer-events:none;animation:hmDealFromCenter .44s cubic-bezier(.19,.78,.27,1) both!important;}
@keyframes hmGatherCenter{from{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}to{transform:translate(var(--hm-gx),var(--hm-gy)) scale(.82)}}
@keyframes hmDealFromCenter{from{transform:translate(var(--hm-deal-x),var(--hm-deal-y)) scale(.82)}to{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}}
@media(max-width:600px){#hojaRepoChoice{gap:13px}.hrChoices{gap:10px;width:95%}.hrCard{width:50%;min-height:120px;padding:7px}.hrCard strong{font-size:13px}.hrCard small{font-size:10px}.hrIcon{font-size:27px}.hrDemo{font-size:9px}.hmSelections:not(.teamCount) .hmPick{min-height:85px;min-width:40%;padding:8px 5px}.hmPick small{font-size:10px;margin-top:4px}.hmHeading{padding-top:44px}}
</style>

<style id="hojaV055QuizAndArcadeCss">
/* Parent top bar not duplicated over the REAL arcade scoreHud. */

#hqCharacter{bottom:calc(21.2963% - 6px)!important}
#hqBalloonBurst{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;left:50%;width:1px;height:1px;z-index:10}
.hqBurstPix{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:0;background:#ffd449;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #663b14;animation:hqBurstPop .42s ease-out forwards;--x:0px;--y:0px}
@keyframes hqBurstPop{from{opacity:1;transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}to{opacity:0;transform:translate(var(--x),var(--y)) scale(.4)}}
.hqEnemy{position:absolute;bottom:calc(21.2963% - 3px);width:64px;height:64px;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;image-rendering:pixelated}
.hqEnemy>img:first-child{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;image-rendering:pixelated;object-fit:contain}
.hqEnemy-jumpy{left:18%}.hqEnemy-hermie{left:29%}.hqEnemy-roach{right:28%}
.hqEnemy-owl{right:18%;bottom:calc(21.2963% + 130px)}.hqEnemy-ghost{left:12%;bottom:calc(21.2963% + 128px)}
.hqEnemy-hermie>img:first-child,.hqEnemy-jumpy>img:first-child,.hqEnemy-ghost>img:first-child{transform:scaleX(-1)}
.hqEnemy .hqHeart{position:absolute;bottom:95%;left:50%;width:40px;height:40px;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(4px);opacity:0;image-rendering:pixelated;transition:none}
.hqEnemy.hqCelebrate>img:first-child{animation:hqHappyHop .42s ease-in-out 2 alternate}
.hqEnemy-owl.hqCelebrate>img:first-child,.hqEnemy-ghost.hqCelebrate>img:first-child{animation:hqHappyWing .22s ease-in-out 4 alternate}
.hqEnemy.hqCelebrate .hqHeart{animation:hqHeartShow 1.4s ease-out both}
@keyframes hqHappyHop{0%,100%{translate:0 0}50%{translate:0 -15px}}

@keyframes hqHeartShow{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(8px)}20%,75%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-20px)}}
.hqResult{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:24;background:#061a27c9;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px}

.hqResultCard{width:min(650px,94%);border:4px solid #d9ba78;border-radius:13px;background:#133a45;color:#fff0cb;text-align:center;padding:25px 20px;box-shadow:6px 7px 0 #06131d}
.hqResultCard h2{font-size:clamp(24px,3.3vw,42px);margin:2px 0 22px}
.hqResultMetrics{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hqResultMetrics span{display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:125px;border:1px solid #7bafab;border-radius:6px;padding:9px;font-size:14px}
.hqResultMetrics b{font-size:28px}
.hqResultActions{display:flex;gap:14px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hqResultActions button{border:2px solid #e4c58c;border-radius:8px;background:#d9b878;color:#17303b;padding:12px 19px;font-weight:850;font-size:17px;cursor:pointer}
#hqStage[data-quiz-finished="true"] #hqBalloon{visibility:hidden}
@media(max-width:660px){#hqBalloon{width:64px!important;height:64px!important}#hqCharacter{bottom:calc(21.2963% - 4px)!important}.hqEnemy{width:32px;height:32px}.hqEnemy-owl,.hqEnemy-ghost{bottom:calc(21.2963% + 67px)}}
/* V0.5.8 QUIZ IDLE: pixel-safe integer enlargement from 32x32 source (4x native).
   Idle locomotion is on wrapper; sprite mirroring/reaction stays on child, so no transform collision. */
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy{
  width:128px!important;height:128px!important;image-rendering:pixelated!important;
  transform-origin:center bottom;will-change:translate;
  bottom:calc(21.2963% - 6px);
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy>img:first-child{
  width:128px!important;height:128px!important;
  object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated!important;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy-jumpy{
  left:14%;animation:hqV057SlimeJump 1.08s steps(8,end) infinite;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy-hermie{
  left:27%;animation:hqV057GroundBob 1.55s steps(2,end) infinite;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy-roach{
  right:22%;animation:hqV057GroundBob 1.15s steps(2,end) infinite reverse;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy-owl{
  right:10%;bottom:calc(21.2963% + 116px)!important;
  animation:hqV057OwlHover 1.8s steps(4,end) infinite;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy-ghost{
  left:6%;bottom:calc(21.2963% + 116px)!important;
  animation:hqV057GhostFloat 3.6s steps(4,end) infinite;
}
/* The original sprites retain their exact integer pixels; no fractional X/Y scaling. */
@keyframes hqV057SlimeJump{
  0%,100%{translate:0 0}
  12.5%,87.5%{translate:0 -8px}
  25%,75%{translate:0 -24px}
  37.5%,62.5%{translate:0 -36px}
  50%{translate:0 -40px}
}
@keyframes hqV057GroundBob{0%,100%{translate:0 0}50%{translate:0 -4px}}
@keyframes hqV057OwlHover{0%,100%{translate:0 -8px}50%{translate:0 8px}}
@keyframes hqV057GhostFloat{0%,100%{translate:0 -4px}50%{translate:0 4px}}
/* Correct answer: every enemy accelerates briefly while the Kenney heart emote is shown. */
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy-jumpy.hqCelebrate{
  animation:hqV057SlimeJump .34s steps(8,end) infinite;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy-hermie.hqCelebrate,
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy-roach.hqCelebrate{
  animation:hqV057GroundBob .27s steps(2,end) infinite;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy-owl.hqCelebrate{
  animation:hqV057OwlHover .42s steps(4,end) infinite;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy-ghost.hqCelebrate{
  animation:hqV057GhostFloat .72s steps(4,end) infinite;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy .hqHeart{
  width:64px;height:64px;bottom:103%;z-index:5;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy.hqCelebrate .hqHeart{
  animation:hqHeartShow 1.45s steps(6,end) both;
}
/* Responsive cards are reflowed without silently reducing sprite pixels. */
@media(max-width:800px){
  #hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy-jumpy{left:5%}
  #hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy-hermie{left:20%}
  #hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy-roach{right:18%}
  #hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy-owl{right:4%}
  #hojaGamePlay[data-mode="quiz"] .hqEnemy-ghost{left:1%}
}

<style id="hojaV059FullscreenStudentUI">
/* V0.6.1: public repository errors are visible independently of private-code panel. */
#hrNotice.hrPublicNotice{max-width:min(820px,94vw);margin:0;padding:10px 16px;
  border:1px solid #d8aa67;border-radius:8px;background:#213b47;color:#ffdbab;
  font-size:clamp(12px,1.2vw,16px);font-weight:750;line-height:1.5;text-align:center;
  overflow-wrap:anywhere;max-height:23vh;overflow:auto;}
#hrNotice[hidden]{display:none!important;}
#hrPublic[disabled]{cursor:wait;filter:saturate(.6);opacity:.75;}

/* V0.6.1 — responsive virtual viewport. Height=540; width follows the
   browser aspect, with uniform scaling and no letterbox bars. */
html,body{width:100%!important;height:100%!important;min-height:0!important;
  margin:0!important;overflow:hidden!important;background:#071622!important;}
body{position:relative!important;display:block!important;}
/* Legacy instrumentation stays in DOM only for scene callbacks; not visible to students. */
body>header,body>.footer,#readyMock,.hcMockBadge,.hrDemo,#hqArcadeInfo,
#progressWrap,#elapsed,.footer .anchors,.footer .note{display:none!important;}
#stage{position:fixed!important;inset:0!important;width:100vw!important;height:100vh!important;
  height:100dvh!important;max-width:none!important;min-height:0!important;
  margin:0!important;padding:0!important;overflow:hidden!important;background:#071622!important;}
#frame{position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;
  max-width:none!important;min-height:0!important;max-height:none!important;
  aspect-ratio:auto!important;border:0!important;border-radius:0!important;
  margin:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;background:#071622!important;overflow:hidden!important;}
#phaserRoot{position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;}
#phaserRoot canvas{display:block!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;
  aspect-ratio:auto!important;object-fit:contain!important;image-rendering:pixelated!important;}
/* Selection UI occupies full available viewport, while background game keeps square pixels. */
#hojaRepoChoice,#hojaCatalog,#hojaNextMode,#hojaGamePlay,#loadingOverlay{max-width:none!important;}

#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="arcade"]>#hqAudioTop{display:none!important;}

@media (orientation:portrait){
 .hcHeader{padding-top:clamp(54px,13vw,90px)!important;}
 .hmHeading{padding-top:clamp(54px,13vw,100px)!important;}
}

<style id="hojaWebtoonBannerR13B">
/* R13B: link text image only (320x166 WebP85); no background/card. */
.hojaWebtoonLink{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  padding:0;background:transparent;border:none;box-shadow:none;outline-offset:5px;
  text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;line-height:0;
  transform:scale(1);transform-origin:center center;
  transition:transform .18s ease,filter .18s ease;
  -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;}
.hojaWebtoonLink img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;}
.hojaWebtoonLink:hover,.hojaWebtoonLink:focus-visible{
  transform:scale(1.08);filter:drop-shadow(0 3px 7px rgba(0,0,0,.48));}
.hojaWebtoonLink:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ffe18f;border-radius:5px;}
#hojaWebtoonIntroBanner{position:absolute;right:clamp(12px,2vw,30px);bottom:clamp(14px,2.5vh,32px);
  width:clamp(120px,16vw,220px);height:auto;max-height:33%;z-index:8;pointer-events:auto;}
/* Keep the intro badge on intro only; every subsequent screen owns its own UI. */
#frame:has(#loadingOverlay:not([hidden])) #hojaWebtoonIntroBanner,
#frame:has(#hojaRepoChoice:not([hidden])) #hojaWebtoonIntroBanner,
#frame:has(#hojaCatalog:not([hidden])) #hojaWebtoonIntroBanner,
#frame:has(#hojaNextMode:not([hidden])) #hojaWebtoonIntroBanner,
#frame:has(#hojaGamePlay:not([hidden])) #hojaWebtoonIntroBanner,
#frame:has(#readyMock:not([hidden])) #hojaWebtoonIntroBanner{display:none!important;}
/* R16B: right fourth row remains the permanent banner lane in 2–7 teams. */
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htRight .htTeamEmptySlot{
  grid-row:4!important;grid-column:1!important;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htRight .htTeamEmptySlot:has(.htWebtoonTeamBanner){
  visibility:visible!important;pointer-events:auto!important;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  position:relative;min-width:0;min-height:0;overflow:visible;
  width:100%;height:100%;}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htRight .htWebtoonTeamBanner{
  position:relative;z-index:5;pointer-events:auto;
  width:min(90%,240px);max-width:100%;max-height:90%;flex:none;}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htRight .htWebtoonTeamBanner img{
  width:100%;height:auto;max-height:min(19vh,158px);object-fit:contain;}
@media (max-width:750px){
  #hojaWebtoonIntroBanner{width:clamp(100px,22vw,165px);}
  #hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htRight .htWebtoonTeamBanner{width:96%;}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.hojaWebtoonLink{transition:none;}}
</style>
<style id="hojaR12TeamGridMC3">
/* R12 team-only symmetrical rows. 7th team occupies the left 4th row; right 4th row remains empty. */
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htLeft,
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htRight {
  display:grid!important; grid-template-rows:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important;
  grid-auto-rows:0!important; align-content:stretch!important;
  justify-content:stretch!important; row-gap:0!important;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamUnit {
  flex:none!important; min-width:0; min-height:0; height:100%!important; width:100%!important;
}
/* Team-only MC3; question stays large, the answers fill just three rows. */
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #hqCard[data-quiz-kind="MC3"] #hqChoices {
  display:grid!important; grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important;
  grid-template-rows:repeat(3,minmax(80px,1fr))!important;
  flex:1 1 auto!important; min-height:0!important;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #hqCard[data-quiz-kind="MC3"] .hqChoice {
  min-height:80px!important; font-size:clamp(27px,2.6vw,41px)!important;
}
/* Keep the score transfer, but avoid exaggerated bright oscillation on active inverse cards. */
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htTeamUnit.scoreGain {
  animation-name:htR12UnitGain!important;
}
@keyframes htR12UnitGain{
  0%,100% {transform:translate(0,0) scale(1)}
  18% {transform:translate(-2px,-2px) rotate(-1.2deg) scale(1.065)}
  38% {transform:translate(2px,0) rotate(.9deg) scale(1.015)}
  60% {transform:translate(-1px,1px) rotate(-.6deg) scale(1.045)}
  78% {transform:translate(1px,0) rotate(.4deg) scale(1.01)}
}
</style>
<style id="hojaR15SevenCharacterRankHudStyles">
/* R15: rank portraits only; side score text and numeric score size remain unchanged. */
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htScores .htTeamName{font-size:clamp(17px,1.8vw,29px)!important;letter-spacing:-.045em!important;min-width:0!important;flex:0 1 auto!important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htScores .htTeamPts{flex:0 0 auto!important} /* preserve R12 score font-size verbatim */
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htRankHud{gap:clamp(4px,.6vw,12px)!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:space-around!important;min-height:0!important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htRankHud .htRankCard{background:transparent!important;border:0!important;box-shadow:none!important;color:inherit!important;outline:0!important;display:flex!important;flex-direction:column!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;gap:0!important;padding:0!important;min-width:0!important;flex:0 1 84px!important;max-width:84px!important;height:70px!important;overflow:visible!important;will-change:transform}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htRankHud .htRankFace{position:relative;display:block;flex:0 0 58px!important;width:62px!important;height:62px!important;overflow:visible!important;pointer-events:none!important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htRankHud .htRankPortrait{display:block!important;position:absolute!important;max-width:none!important;max-height:none!important;object-fit:fill!important;pointer-events:none!important;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 2px #0018279a)}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htRankHud .htRankPlace{display:block!important;text-align:center!important;font-size:clamp(11px,1vw,14px)!important;font-weight:1000!important;line-height:1!important;color:#ffe3a0!important;text-shadow:0 1px 2px #06111c!important;background:transparent!important;white-space:nowrap!important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htRankHud .htRankCard.playing{background:none!important;box-shadow:none!important}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htRankHud .htRankCard.rankUp .htRankFace{animation:htRankUpFlash .8s ease-in-out}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htRankHud .htRankCard.rankDown .htRankFace{animation:htRankDownFlash .8s ease-in-out}
@keyframes htRankUpFlash{30%{transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.14);filter:brightness(1.3)}100%{transform:none;filter:none}}
@keyframes htRankDownFlash{35%{transform:translateY(3px) scale(.92);filter:brightness(.75)}100%{transform:none;filter:none}}
@media(max-width:1000px){#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htScores .htTeamName{font-size:clamp(12px,1.9vw,22px)!important}}
@media(max-width:620px){#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] .htScores .htTeamName{font-size:clamp(10px,1.75vw,15px)!important}#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="team"] #htRankHud .htRankFace{transform:scale(.76);transform-origin:bottom center}}
</style>
<style id="hojaR17GSingleArcadeHudFix">
/* R17G: the host owns ONE back/music/SFX control strip in solo arcade.
   Inner arcade scoreHud still owns only gameplay metrics. */
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="arcade"]:not([hidden]) > #hqPlayBack{
  display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;
  position:absolute!important;top:clamp(8px,2.2%,15px)!important;left:clamp(8px,1.5%,18px)!important;
  height:36px!important;min-height:36px!important;width:92px!important;min-width:92px!important;
  box-sizing:border-box!important;padding:5px 7px!important;font-size:13px!important;
  z-index:220!important;white-space:nowrap!important;pointer-events:auto!important;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="arcade"]:not([hidden]) > #hqAudioTop{
  display:flex!important;position:absolute!important;
  top:clamp(8px,2.2%,15px)!important;
  left:calc(clamp(8px,1.5%,18px) + 105px)!important;
  gap:6px!important;align-items:center!important;z-index:220!important;
  pointer-events:auto!important;
}
#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="arcade"]:not([hidden]) > #hqAudioTop button{
  height:36px!important;min-height:36px!important;width:92px!important;min-width:92px!important;
  padding:5px 7px!important;font-size:13px!important;box-sizing:border-box!important;
}
/* Parent catalog's separate controls must not float above the arcade HUD. */
body:has(#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="arcade"]:not([hidden])) #hojaSharedBack,
body:has(#hojaGamePlay[data-mode="arcade"]:not([hidden])) #hojaAudioTop{
  display:none!important;pointer-events:none!important;
}
@media(max-width:660px){
  #hojaGamePlay[data-mode="arcade"]:not([hidden]) > #hqPlayBack{
    width:76px!important;min-width:76px!important;height:30px!important;min-height:30px!important;
    padding:3px!important;font-size:10px!important;
  }
  #hojaGamePlay[data-mode="arcade"]:not([hidden]) > #hqAudioTop{
    left:calc(clamp(8px,1.5%,18px) + 82px)!important;gap:4px!important;
  }
  #hojaGamePlay[data-mode="arcade"]:not([hidden]) > #hqAudioTop button{
    width:66px!important;min-width:66px!important;height:30px!important;min-height:30px!important;
    padding:3px!important;font-size:10px!important;
  }
}
</style>
</head><body>
<header><div><div class="eyebrow">HOJA / STEP 14-1 / PHASER DEMO</div><h1>호자 게임</h1><p>STEP 13-7의 64×64 원본, V2 지형, 배경 및 게임 효과 함수 재사용</p></div><span id="status">원본 게임 에셋 준비 중…</span></header>

<a id="hojaWebtoonIntroBanner" class="hojaWebtoonLink" href="https://comic.naver.com/challenge/detail?titleId=851281&no=1" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="호자 웹툰 박물관이야기 새 탭에서 보기" title="호자 웹툰 새 탭에서 열기"><img id="hojaWebtoonIntroImage" src="data:image/webp;base64," width="320" height="166" alt="서울시교육청에서 대차게 까인 박물관이야기 웹툰" decoding="async"></a>

    <div class="loadingCenter"><span id="loadingMessage" class="loadingText">문제 목록을 불러오는 중</span><span id="loadingDots" class="loadingDots">...</span><div class="loadingTrack" aria-hidden="true"><div class="loadingFill"></div></div></div>
    <div class="loadingActor"><img id="loadingNahan" class="loadingCharacter" alt="인사하는 나한상"><div class="loadingName">나한상</div></div>

  <button type="button" id="hrPrivate" class="hrCard"><span class="hrIcon" aria-hidden="true">🔒</span><strong>개인 카트리지</strong><small>5자리 참여 코드로 입장하기</small></button>
 </div>
